title: Culminating Report
description: Students complete a report that demonstrates a synthesis and integration of coursework and other learning experiences in preparation for professional public health practice.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of PHSP 508B, PHSP 590 (if taken in the same topic).
Students must pass both PHSP 589 and PHSP 508B. If one or both of PHSP 589 or PHSP 508B are failed, both must be repeated.
